away.summary: The Boston Bruins are coming off a 4-2-0 record without Charlie McAvoy, who is set to make his season debut after serving a suspension. McAvoy expressed excitement about rejoining the team as they find their stride on a four-game road trip starting in San Jose. home.summary: The San Jose Sharks are led by captain Macklin Celebrini, who is an early favorite for the Hart Trophy after a strong start to the season. Celebrini has shown resilience, returning from a lower-body injury to contribute immediately. The team has improved significantly from last season and is expected to make the playoffs if Celebrini stays healthy.
